obituary.name: Miss Clara Digit-Phone
obituary.headline: A fine device, recently offline

cause.text: Her service concluded when the display developed spiderweb cracks.

life.text: Miss Digit-Phone held court upon the kitchen counter, her black glossy screen having seen countless blurry photos of the cat.
She served the family well, often residing near the hearth, her red bottom bezel catching the light during evening news reports.

obituary.survived_by: a pair of reading glasses and the wireless charging pad.
obituary.in_lieu_of_flowers: please ensure the power cord is neatly coiled.
obituary.epitaph: It saw the world, even when its face was fractured.

obituary.name: Miss Elara Digit-Screenworth
obituary.headline: A Brief Service in the Modern Household

cause.text: She met her end when the display developed a spiderweb crack.

life.text: Miss Digit-Screenworth provided constant illumination for the evening hours, though her casing bore several faint scratches from its time resting upon the pine mantelpiece.
Its vibrant red border often provided a certain flair when placed beside the sugar bowl, and it reliably served as the holder for evening messages.

obituary.survived_by: a charging cable of indeterminate length and a remote control with missing batteries
obituary.in_lieu_of_flowers: we ask that the batteries in the wireless mouse be replaced.
obituary.epitaph: It showed the world, then it dimmed. Quietly now.

obituary.name: Mr. Percival Crispington, Crust
obituary.headline: A fine specimen, browned for the daily breakfast

cause.text: Mr. Crispington passed away from significant charred surface damage.

life.text: He began his service with a handsome golden brown crust, serving well on Tuesday mornings.
His tenure was marked by a slight discoloration, a quiet period spent near the edge of the butter dish.
He spent his final hours bearing burnt edges, a small tragedy near the corner of his square shape.

obituary.survived_by: a butter knife with one missing point and the small dish holding the jam.
obituary.in_lieu_of_flowers: please ensure the toaster coils are kept clean.
obituary.epitaph: A fine slice, offered up to the morning light.

obituary.name: Edmund Crispy Toastsworth
obituary.headline: A fine specimen, well-browned in his final moments

cause.text: He passed away due to a thoroughly charred surface.

life.text: He was a square shape, holding his golden brown color with quiet dignity during his time on the breakfast plate.
His edges developed a burn, a slight discoloration marking a particularly spirited morning near the toaster.

obituary.survived_by: a butter knife whose blade is perpetually dull, and several crumbs of indeterminate origin.
obituary.in_lieu_of_flowers: please ensure the butter dish is wiped clean after use.
obituary.epitaph: A brief, golden existence. A worthy morning.

obituary.name: Mr. Josiah Gourdington
obituary.headline: A Grand Jack-O'-Lantern, Now Quiet

cause.text: Mr. Gourdington passed away due to advanced rotting.

life.text: He was a prominent fixture of the autumn display, his orange color catching the afternoon light near the front stoop.
His life was marked by collecting dirt over his surface while proudly displaying his carved features.
Even his stout stem, noted on the largest specimen, saw many twilight gatherings indoors.

obituary.survived_by: a collection of mismatched ceramic platters and a single, dusty doily.
obituary.in_lieu_of_flowers: please wipe down the silver serving tray.
obituary.epitaph: A fine glow for a short while.

obituary.name: Silas Gourdington III
obituary.headline: A Great Jack-o'-Lantern, Now Quiet

cause.text: He passed away after developing small areas of rot across his form.

life.text: Silas was an orange fixture in the hearth alcove, his carved visage providing welcome illumination to the evening gathering.
For several crisp months, he sat upon the sill, his skin sometimes marked by surface dust, a quiet observer of the afternoon light.
He was a fine specimen, his sturdy girth complemented by a modest stalk upon his apex.

obituary.survived_by: a slightly damp doily and the accumulated crumbs from autumn gatherings.
obituary.in_lieu_of_flowers: kindly wipe down the adjacent countertop.
obituary.epitaph: His bright days offered such good cheer.

drafts.name: Mr. Silas Gourdington
drafts.headline: A handsome face, now quiet.

cause_of_death.text: His structure ultimately gave way due to several visible cracks on his skin.

life.text: Mr. Gourdington was a fixture in the porch display, his bright orange hue (d4) providing much cheer during the early autumn nights. He often held the stern, carved expressions (d5) of a watchful ancestor.

Though some of his brethren showed signs of decay (d2), his larger form, complete with a firm stem (d6), held its shape admirably near the steps. He collected a fine patina of surface dirt (d3) from the afternoon drizzle.

drafts.survived_by: a very dusty doormat and three unlit candles.
drafts.in_lieu_of_flowers: In lieu of flowers, please ensure the skirting boards are wiped down.
drafts.epitaph: He brought light, even as the shadows grew.
